(= cl. ἐλπίζειν), [[r:ACT.24.15|Act 24:15]], [[r:ROM.15.4|Rom 15:4]], [[r:2CO.3.12|2Co 3:12 10:15]], [[r:EPH.2.12|Eph 2:12]], [[r:1TH.4.13|1Th 4:13]]; before ἐπί, with dative, [[r:1JN.3.3|1Jn 3:3]]; εἰς, [[r:ACT.24.15|Act 24:15]]; ὅτι, [[r:ROM.8.20|Rom 8:20]], [[r:PHP.1.20|Php 1:20-21]]. G1686.strongs: to whelm on, i.e. wet (a part of the person, etc.) by contact with a fluid

G1687.root: from [[w:G1722]] and a presumed derivative of the base of [[w:G0939]]
senses: to step in or on (Soph.), hence
to frequent, haunt, dwell in (Æsch., Eur.); metaphorically, [[r:COL.2.18|Col 2:18]] (dwelling in, R, txt.; taking, R, mg.);
to invade (1Mac, ll with; metaphorically, Col, Lc.).

to enter on, come into possession of (Eur., Dem.; LXX, Jos, H. with); on the difficulties of reading and interpretation in this passage, see Lft, Col., 194 f., 252; ICC, 268 ff.; Field, Notes, 197; Milligan, NTD, 177; and for exx. from π., MM, Exp., xii (cf. κενεμβ.).† (AS)

G1688.strongs: causative of); to place on, i.e. transfer (aboard a vessel)
senses: to put on board ship, embark: with accusative of person(s), before εἰς, [[r:ACT.27.6|Act 27:6.]]† (AS)

senses: ἐμ-βλέπω to look at: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MRK.8.25|Mrk 8:25]]; with dative of person(s) (part., before λέγει, εἶπεν, cf. Xen., Cyr., i, 3, 2), [[r:MAT.19.26|Mat 19:26]], [[r:MRK.10.21|Mrk 10:21, 27 14:67]], [[r:LUK.20.17|Luk 20:17 22:61]] (ἐνέβλεψεν), [[r:JHN.1.36|Jhn 1:36, 43]]; absol., to look, [[r:ACT.22.11|Act 22:11]]; metaphorically, to consider: [[r:MAT.6.26|Mat 6:26.]]† (AS)

G1690.root: from [[w:G1722]] and βριμάομαι (to snort with anger)
G1690.strongs: to have indignation on, i.e. (transitively) to blame, (intransitively) to sigh with chagrin, (specially) to sternly enjoin
senses: ἐμ-βριμάομαι (T, -έομαι; Bl., § 22, 1), -ῶμαι (βρίμη, strength, bulk, whence βριμάομαι, to snort with anger), depon., with aor. mid. and pass., to snort in (of horses, Æsch.), hence, to speak or act with deep feeling (DCG, i, 62b);
to be moved with anger (cf. ἐμβρίμημα, [[r:LAM.2.6|La 2:6]]): with dative, [[r:MRK.14.5|Mrk 14:5]], [[r:JHN.11.33|Jhn 11:33]]; ἐν ἑαυτῷ, [[r:JHN.11.38|Jhn 11:38]];

G1693.strongs: to rave on, i.e. rage at

G1694.strongs: God with us; Emmanuel, a name of Christ

senses: Emmaus, a place 60 furlongs from Jerusalem: [[r:LUK.24.13|Luk 24:13.]]† (AS)

G1696.strongs: to stay in the same place, i.e. (figuratively) persevere
senses: to abide by, be true to: before ἐν; τ. πίστει, [[r:ACT.14.22|Act 14:22]]; τ. διαθήκῃ, [[r:HEB.8.9|Heb 8:9]] (LXX); with dative, τ. γεγραμμένοις (dative ptcp. as in legal formula; cf. Deiss., BS, 248; MM, Exp., xii): [[r:GAL.3.10|Gal 3:10]] (LXX).† (AS)

poss. prop. of first of person(s), representing the em­phasized genitive ἐμοῦ, mine, subjectively and objectively, i.e. belonging to, proceeding from or related to me: [[r:MAT.18.20|Mat 18:20]], [[r:MRK.8.38|Mrk 8:38]], [[r:JHN.3.29|Jhn 3:29]] (most frequently in this gospel), al.; absol., τὸ ἐμόν, τὰ ἐμά, [[r:MAT.20.15|Mat 20:15 25:27]], [[r:LUK.15.31|Luk 15:31]], [[r:JHN.10.14|Jhn 10:14 16:14-15 17:10]]; = genitive obj. (cl.), εἰς τ. ἐμὴν ἀvάμνησιν, [[r:LUK.22.19|Luk 22:19]], [[r:1CO.11.24|1Co 11:24-25]]; with genitive expl., τ. ἐμῇ χειρὶ Παύλου, [[r:1CO.16.21|1Co 16:21]], [[r:COL.4.18|Col 4:18]], [[r:2TH.3.17|2Th 3:17]] (AS)
ἐγώ, genitive, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς, of person(s) pron. I.

The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in [[r:MAT.3.11|Mat 3:11]], [[r:MRK.1.8|Mrk 1:8]], [[r:LUK.3.16|Luk 3:16]], al. But often there is no apparent emphasis, as [[r:MAT.10.16|Mat 10:16]], [[r:JHN.10.17|Jhn 10:17]]; ἰδοὺ ἐ. (= Heb. הִנֵּנִי, cf. [[r:1KI.3.8|1Ki 3:8]]), [[r:ACT.9.10|Act 9:10]]; ἐ. (like Heb. אֲנִי), I am, [[r:JHN.1.23|Jhn 1:23]] (LXX), [[r:ACT.7.32|Act 7:32]] (LXX).

The enclitic forms (see supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, [[r:JHN.14.20|Jhn 14:20]]; μου τ. λόγους, [[r:MAT.7.24|Mat 7:24]]; ὀπίσω μου, [[r:MAT.3.11|Mat 3:11]]; ἰσχυρότερός μου, ib.; λέγει μοι, [[r:REV.5.5|Rev 5:5]]; also with the prep. πρός, as [[r:MRK.9.19|Mrk 9:19]], al. The full forms (ἐμοῦ, etc.) are used with the other prepositions, as δι᾽ ἐμοῦ, ἐν ἐμοί, εἰς ἐμέ, etc., also for emphasis, as [[r:LUK.10.16|Luk 10:16]], [[r:JHN.7.23|Jhn 7:23]], [[r:MRK.14.7|Mrk 14:7]], al. (with) The genitive μου and ἡμῶν are often used for the poss. pronouns ἐμός, ἡμέτερος: τ. λαόν μου, [[r:MAT.2.6|Mat 2:6]]; μου τῂ ἀπιστιᾳ, [[r:MRK.9.24|Mrk 9:24.]]

τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί ( = Heb. מַה־לִי וָלָךְ, [[r:JDG.11.12|Jdg 11:12]], al.), i.e. what have we in common: [[r:MAT.8.29|Mat 8:29]], [[r:MRK.1.24|Mrk 1:24, 5:7]], [[r:LUK.8.28|Luk 8:28]], [[r:JHN.2.4|Jhn 2:4]]; τί γάρ μοι, [[r:1CO.5.2|1Co 5:2.]]
The interchange of ἐγώ and ἡμεῖς, common in π., appears in Pauline Epp. (see M, Pr., 86f., M, Th., 131f.).
